_comment: The ruling family (Expansion 1.2). Authored by the Head Writer / Game Director (Gemini) — canon.
Read by src/engine/court.py. Systems numbers (ages, influence, starting cabinet, generated extra
relatives and nobles, trait mechanics) live in data/court.json.

family.name: Lady Elara
family.description: Her presence stabilizes the home front, but she constantly advocates for peace talks.

family.name: Julian
family.description: He will blindly follow any military order to prove himself. If he dies in combat, succession is in jeopardy.

family.name: Duke Vargus
family.description: A brilliant administrator who keeps the Treasury full, but constantly embezzles funds. Dangerous to cross.

family.name: General Silas
family.description: Excellent at leading men, but his paranoia leads to false arrests among your staff.
